newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel oil resists crude's drop.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel oil resists crude's drop.

text.p: Low sulphur straight-run fuel oil resisted the downward pull of crude futures on Monday, but activity was very slow as the market digested easing Middle East tension.
"It has not suffered because last week's gains were not as sharp as crude," said one trader. A deal on Friday at $135 fob NWE gave the market its level on Monday. Supplies were seen tightish.
E-4 cargo prices have been capped by good avails with levels assessed around formula +$3. In the Med a 50,000 tonne M-40, offered on Friday and still available, was at formula +$6.
